column3: (Non-storable content: API and HTML responses are deliberately not cached)
(Timestamp disclosure: the demo session token and expires_in carry its own expiry by design)
(Server error: /api/payments/* answer 503 on purpose while Razorpay is not configured)
(Suspicious comments: words like "user" or "select" inside minified third-party JavaScript, not developer notes)
(Modern web application: informational, the app is a single-page React app)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp would block the Google sign-in popup and Razorpay checkout; COOP and CORP are set)
(HTTP only site: CI scans the locally started servers over plain http; production is https-only with HSTS)
